In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the emergency braking system for vertical axis wind turbines is a system that has to be designed in such a way that the turbine stops as soon as possible.
the emergency brake system for the VAWT with PMSG should be made with electrical braking system and mechanical braking system.
the electrical brake system is not able to work in all emergency cases and the mechanical brake is the only solution to stop the VAWT in all emergency cases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
in the case to use the permanent magnet generator the active resistor is the best option to stop the turbine.
the emergency brake system is the system that is used to stop the wind turbine in the emergency cases when the MPPT system is not able to control the turbine.

the electrical braking is used in the emergency system as the main brake for the VAWT with PMSG, but the mechanical brake is used as additional brake or as the main brake in the case the PMSG is malfunction or is damaged.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the electrical brake is the most effective and safe method for emergency brake.
the electrical brake can be used in emergency condition if the generator type is permanent magnet synchronous generator and the generator can be controlled by MPPT controller.
the emergency braking systems can be designed and tested with simulation and it is very useful to have the simulation model for emergency brake system.
